# Format Factory — Repeatability Contract
# Version: 1.0
# Generated by: FORMAT-FACTORY-GOVERNANCE-REPEATABILITY-IDEMPOTENCY-CONTRACTS-001
# Date: 2026-06-08

## Definition

A product source mutation is REPEATABLE only if an independent agent, given only the
artifacts declared in its evidence, can produce an equivalent or identical source change.

## Forbidden Equivalences (hard rules)
- tests_pass DOES NOT equal repeatable
- queue_item_exists DOES NOT equal repeatable
- sprint_accepted DOES NOT equal repeatable
- memory_entry_claims_cycles DOES NOT equal repeatable

## Repeatability Levels

### NOT_REPEATABLE
Evidence required: none captured. Allowed claims: WORKS only.

### DOCUMENTED_ONLY
Evidence required: natural language description, sidecar attribution, tests pass.
Allowed claims: WORKS, DOCUMENTED.

### REPLAYABLE_BY_HUMAN_AGENT
Evidence required: skill_id, skill_version, explicit inputs, validation_log,
source_diff_path, idempotency_key, skill_transcript_path.
Allowed claims: WORKS, GOVERNED.

### REPLAYABLE_BY_GOVERNED_AGENT
Evidence required: all REPLAYABLE_BY_HUMAN_AGENT evidence PLUS prompt_artifact_path,
model_id, agent_id, replay_recipe_path.
Allowed claims: WORKS, GOVERNED, REPLAYABLE.

### REPLAYABLE_BY_QUEUE_OR_BACKEND
Evidence required: action_id, queue_item_id, execution_result_json_path,
before_sha256, after_sha256, source_diff_path, idempotency_key, guard_check_pass=true,
validation_log.
Allowed claims: WORKS, GOVERNED, REPLAYABLE, QUEUE_BACKED.

### REPLAYED_AND_PROVEN
Evidence required: all REPLAYABLE_BY_QUEUE_OR_BACKEND PLUS replay_run_log_path,
replay_result (NO_OP or EQUIVALENT_DIFF from actual execution).
Allowed claims: all claims.
